item.title: Seychelles Vice-President Sebastien Pillay visits NBCC headquarters, discusses projects in island nation
item.description: Speaking on the occasion, CMD, NBCC, reaffirmed the company’s commitment to delivering high-quality, sustainable infrastructure solutions and expressed confidence in further deepening cooperation with Seychelles across multiple sectors.

item.title: Airtel and Perplexity end AI partnership: Now Airtel announced collaboration with Adobe
item.description: Bharti Airtel and Perplexity AI have concluded their partnership months after offering free Perplexity Pro access to 360 million users. The telecom company has now moved ahead with a new 12-month Adobe subscription offer for its customers.

item.title: Silver jumps 18% from this year’s low: What are the new potential boosters?
item.description: First silver prices confounded investors with their leap reaching about Rs 4.2 lakh a kg within two months of hitting the Rs 2 lakh mark. Then came a steep fall which puzzled many late investors. But the prices of the white silver has started rising again.

item.title: New survey shows majority in US believe Trump moving country in wrong direction
item.description: The survey was seen to be divided across party lines. Democrats and independents were far more likely to see weakness in the state of the union whereas a significant majority of Republicans continue to describe the country as strong.

item.title: Canada moves to revoke Tahawwur Rana’s citizenship ahead of PM Carney’s India visit
item.description: Canada moves to revoke Tahawwur Rana’s citizenship for misrepresentation, not terrorism, ahead of PM Mark Carney’s India visit. This action aims to improve strained Canada-India ties, as Rana, the 26/11 Mumbai terror suspect, faces revocation for false residency claims to IRCC. The case is now before the Federal Court, safeguarding the integrity of Canada’s citizenship system.

item.title: Football match halted in Istanbul as player performs CPR in bid to save seagull struck by ball
item.description: A football match was stopped during an Istanbul amateur league final after a footballer performed CPR on a seagull struck by the ball. The dramatic rescue, carried out on the pitch before medical staff stepped in, quickly became an extraordinary moment of compassion in sport.

item.title: Holi 2026: How to make perfect street-style Dahi Bhalla at home for parties and celebrations
item.description: Holi celebrations feel incomplete without a plate of soft, chilled dahi bhalla topped with sweet and tangy chutneys. If you’re planning your festive menu for 2026, this timeless favourite deserves a special spot on your table. Here’s how to make it unforgettable this year.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh: 1 person dead, 24 sick after diarrhoea outbreak in Srikakulam
item.description: Residents of Dammala Veedhi, Kaki Veedhi, Gudi Veedhi and Manguvari Thota, who developed symptoms are currently under treatment at GGH and a few other private hospitals.

item.title: After SIR in Tamil Nadu: A look at voter deletions from Kolathur to Edappadi and other VIP constituencies
item.description: Tamil Nadu voters 2026 | Following the completion of the SIR exercise that began on October 27, 2025, Tamil Nadu’s total voter count now stands at 5.67 crore, reflecting a drop of approximately 74 lakh voters or 11.5 percent from the pre-revision figure of 6.41 crore.

item.title: Redbird aviation under scanner after Jharkhand air ambulance crash exposes years of safety failures
item.description: Experts question why a company with documented failures continues operations, demanding an overhaul of charter service monitoring to prevent future tragedies.
